item.title: K8S Static Pod Lifecycle in Practice: From kubeadm Bootstrap Principles to Control Plane Fault Drills
item.description: A deep dive into the Kubernetes Static Pod working mechanism and kubelet daemon logic, uncovering how kubeadm bootstraps the four core control plane components, hands-on custom static Pod self-healing verification, and control plane apiserver fault injection and recovery drills.
